title: Check and advise service write-ups
summary: This topic groups brief service write-ups centered on "check and advise," with the concrete issues ranging from a reverse camera failure and drivetrain warning with power loss to noisy wipers, while several fragments are too sparse to identify a specific concern.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe specific vehicle problems brought in for diagnosis, including a right-side camera not working in reverse, a drivetrain malfunction warning with loss of power, and very noisy windshield wipers.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly minimal service-intake phrases such as "check and advise" or incomplete complaint notes, so the underlying customer issue is not always clear.

limitations: Several fragments are extremely short or incomplete, which limits identification of the actual customer concern.
The topic mixes generic service-intake wording with unrelated specific issues, so the examples do not form a single coherent problem theme.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of all reviews on this topic.
